notes:
- New perk: Quick Fix (the light yellow machine, on every map). Solo: when you'd die, you get back
  up once at full health with 2 seconds to get clear (the perk is used up). Co-op: you revive teammates
  50% faster. Either way you heal sooner after a hit (1.6 s instead of 3.5 s) and faster.
- Gunsmith screen (LOADOUT) redone: the slots are tabs that show what's fitted. Every attachment and
  camo is a card with its stat changes in green and red (+15% Damage, -20% Recoil...), camo cards show a
  swatch of the pattern, and locked ones show what they need with a progress bar (headshots for gun camos).
  Hover a card to try it on: the gun preview and the stats change before you pick it.
- Grenades: hold G (LB on a controller) to pull the pin and cook it. Your hand comes up with the
  grenade, the fuse ticks faster as it runs down, and when you let go you wind up and throw it overhand
  with whatever fuse is left, so a cooked grenade goes off right as it lands. Hold it past 2.5 seconds
  and it goes off in your hand.
- Melee weapons stay in view: while you hold a melee weapon (3), it's out in front of you, low on the
  right and angled up, instead of resting off screen over your shoulder. It sways a little, and the swing
  eases out of that pose.
- Fixes: the Longshot's bolt no longer turns sideways and sticks out of the gun; the Fire Axe's blade
  now faces the way you chop (it was on backwards).
